general.title: THE COVEN GATHERING
general.subtitle: Four covens. One fandom. Every effort matters.

clans.name: CULLEN
clans.description: You are the ENGENE who keeps people connected. You naturally look out for others, encourage the fandom, and believe that supporting ENHYPEN is something we do together.

clans.name: VOLTURI
clans.description: You are the ENGENE who moves when action is needed. When ENHYPEN needs support, you bring determination, urgency, and the willingness to push through until the very end.

clans.name: DENALI
clans.description: You are the steady ENGENE. You may not always be the loudest, but you keep showing up, doing your part, and supporting ENHYPEN consistently.

clans.name: EGYPTIAN
clans.description: You are the strategic ENGENE. You observe the situation, adapt when things change, and look for practical ways to make every effort count for ENHYPEN.

quiz.title: WHAT KIND OF ENGENE ARE YOU?

questions.title: ENHYPEN’S COMEBACK IS HERE.
questions.text: The fandom is busy and there are many things that need to be done. What do you naturally find yourself doing?
answers: Make sure everyone stays together and knows what to prioritize.
Take initiative and get people moving immediately.
Focus on consistently doing your part without getting distracted.
Look at everything happening and figure out the most useful strategy.

questions.title: THE VOTING DEADLINE IS GETTING CLOSE.
questions.text: Resources are limited and ENGENEs need to stay focused. What is your instinct?
answers: Coordinate with others so nobody is left behind.
Push everyone to act before time runs out.
Stay consistent and keep collecting what is needed.
Reassess the situation and adjust the strategy.

questions.title: AN ENGENE ASKS FOR HELP.
questions.text: “I’m confused. How do I vote for ENHYPEN?” What would you most likely do?
answers: Walk them through it and make sure they feel supported.
Give them the essential instructions and get them started.
Explain it patiently and let them work at their own pace.
Find the clearest guide or information and show them the best route.

questions.title: ENGENES ARE SUPPOSED TO BE VOTING.
questions.text: Instead, people are arguing with another fandom. What do you naturally do?
answers: Remind everyone why we’re here and bring the focus back to ENHYPEN.
Tell people to stop wasting time and get back to voting.
Ignore the argument and continue supporting ENHYPEN.
Avoid unnecessary conflict and redirect people toward useful information.

questions.title: ONLY A FEW HOURS ARE LEFT.
questions.text: The fandom is tired. What kind of ENGENE do you become?
answers: Encourage everyone and keep the group motivated until the end.
Push through and make sure the remaining tasks are completed.
Keep doing your part steadily until voting closes.
Look for the most effective way to use the remaining time.

questions.title: A NEW VOTING PRIORITY APPEARS.
questions.text: The original plan suddenly needs to change. What is your first instinct?
answers: Check with the team so everyone understands the change.
Switch immediately and start acting.
Stay calm and continue with what can realistically be done.
Compare the new situation with the old plan before deciding.

questions.title: SUPPORTING ENHYPEN.
questions.text: What does supporting ENHYPEN mean most to you?
answers: Making sure ENGENEs support each other while supporting ENHYPEN.
Giving everything you can when ENHYPEN needs you.
Being there consistently, even when nobody is watching.
Finding effective ways to turn our collective effort into results.

questions.title: ONE LAST QUESTION.
questions.text: ENHYPEN needs ENGENEs to stay united. What do you believe you naturally bring to the fandom?
answers: Loyalty and connection.
Determination and action.
Steadiness and reliability.
Strategy and adaptability.

content.intro: An ENGENE fan-made participation gathering for ENHYPEN. Find your coven, show up together, and make every day count.
